name: WireGuardModule
description: ESPRack module: on-demand WireGuard tunnel to mothership. Curve25519 keypair generated via mbedtls on first boot, persisted encrypted in SecretsVault. Tunnel comes up on actionOpenTunnel from server, down on actionCloseTunnel or on idle teardown command. See docs/plans/wireguard-tunnel.md for the full architecture.
